newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via $1.5 billion customer RP's.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via $1.5 billion customer RP's.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves to the banking system on Monday via $1.5 billion customer repurchase agreements, analysts said.
The Fed's add move was expected, although many analysts had called for a more aggressive injection of reserves through three-day fixed system repurchase agreements.
At 1130 EDT/1530 GMT, the time when the Fed usually intervenes in the market, the federal funds rate stood at 5-3/16 percent, below the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target.
